description: Na₂Tm₂B₂TeO₁₀ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.95 Å. Tm is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Tm-O bond distances ranging from 2.18-2.45 Å. B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.36-1.42 Å. Te is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Te-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.01 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Tm, and one B atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na, two equivalent Tm, and one Te atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONaTm₂Te tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one B, and one Te atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, two equivalent Tm, and one B atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Tm, and one Te atom.
